events.title: 스티브 매클래런 begins his job as England manager.
리즈 유나이티드 chairman Ken Bates reports his former club 첼시 to The Football Association , Premier League and FIFA over the alleged 'tapping-up' of three Leeds youth team players.
The Football League season begins, with 루턴 타운 beating 레스터 시티 2–0 in the first game.
The 500,000th goal in the history of English league football ( FA Premier League and Football League ) was scored by 허더즈필드 타운 's Gary Taylor-Fletcher in their 3–0 victory over 로더럼 유나이티드 .
존 테리 is appointed as the new captain of England.
The Football Conference begins, along with most other non-league campaigns.
리버풀 take the first silverware of the season, as they beat 첼시 2–1 in the FA Community Shield at the Millennium Stadium in Cardiff .
CONMEBOL Copa Libertadores final game , 인테르나시오나우 vs. São Paulo . 인테르나시오나우 won the cup after the draw in 2–2 in the second game. In first game, 인테르나시오나우 won by 2–1.
The Premier League season begins with 셰필드 유나이티드 and 리버풀 drawing 1–1.

맨체스터 시티 defender Ben Thatcher elbows 포츠머스 's 페드루 필리프 멘드스 in the face at the City of Manchester Stadium , after the two challenged for the same ball. This left Mendes unconscious and needing hospital treatment. Thatcher was shown a yellow card for the incident, but he was later banned by his club and charged with violent misconduct by The FA . Ole Gunnar Solskjær scores his first competitive goal in more than three years in 맨체스터 유나이티드's 3–0 away league win over 찰턴 애슬레틱 .
첼시 are fined £40,000 by The FA for breaching doping regulations.

August ends with last season's runners-up 맨체스터 유나이티드 top of the Premiership with three wins out of three. 포츠머스 , 애스턴 빌라 , 에버턴 , 첼시 , 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 리버풀 complete the top seven. 왓퍼드 , 셰필드 유나이티드 and 블랙번 로버스 prop up the table with one point each from their opening three matches, with 아스널 only above the relegation zone on goal difference. 카디프 시티 lead the Championship, with 노리치 시티, 크리스털 팰리스, 버밍엄 시티 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 all three points behind the Welsh club and 번리 completing the top six, ahead of 플리머스 아가일 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 on goal difference. 선덜랜드, despite playing in a lower division, have failed to turn around their poor form from the previous season and stand in the Championship drop zone, sandwiched by 콜체스터 유나이티드 and 헐 시티. 노팅엄 포리스트 lead the way in League One, with 포트 베일 second. Bradford, Tranmere, 브렌트퍼드 and 첼트넘 타운 completing the top six. Rotherham, only bottom after a 10 point deduction for due to entering a Company Voluntary Agreement, 스컨소프 유나이티드 and 노샘프턴 타운 sandwiching 밀월, failing to turn around their fortunes after relegation last season. 스윈던 타운, 월솔 and 밀턴킨스 던스 lie in the automatic promotion places, with Peterborough and Lincoln a point behind. Wycombe and Wrecham complete the play-off places. 매클즈필드 타운 and 로치데일 in the drop zone.
